Privacy.metaDescription: What data this site collects and how it is used.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This site uses no tracking cookies and never sells data. Here is what is collected and why.
Privacy.visitsBody: Each page view is recorded together with its language. To count unique visitors per day, your IP address and browser type are turned into a one-way random code with a key that changes every day, so you cannot be identified or followed across days. Raw IP addresses are never stored. Raw records are deleted after 90 days; only daily totals are kept.
Privacy.contactBody: Your name, email, subject, and message are stored so I can reply. Your IP address is only kept as a random code to prevent spam. Messages are kept until I delete them.
Privacy.newsletterBody: Your email is stored once you confirm through the link in the email. You can unsubscribe anytime from the link in every email, and I will delete your data on request.
Privacy.cvBody: Only the number of downloads and the page language are recorded, with no personal data.
Privacy.servicesBody: The site runs on Vercel, the database on Neon (Singapore), images and the CV on Cloudinary, and email is sent through Resend. Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights record visit counts and page speed without cookies, using page addresses without parameters. Server errors are reported to Sentry without personal data. Each receives only the data it needs to do its job.
Privacy.rightsBody: You can ask for a copy or deletion of your data through the contact page.
